runbook.statementMd: You have two ropes. Each takes exactly sixty minutes to burn, but they burn unevenly. How do you measure forty five minutes?
acceptedAnswers: Light the first rope at both ends and the second at one end. When the first finishes, 30 minutes have passed; light the other end of the second, which then burns out 15 minutes later.

hintLadder.text: What happens if you light a rope at both ends?

rubric.text: Realised that lighting both ends halves the burn time
Justified the answer step by step
